snippet.title: Vanquish The Eternal - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The newest game from solo developer Wilhelm G, coming to steam in 2025. 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3564270/Vanquish_The_Eternal/

FEATURING JONBREAKSBADNEWS as the Alchemist! 

"On the eve of October's thirtieth and first, when All Hallows' Eve falls upon the land, there doth arose from the bowels of the earth creatures most vile and twisted. Fiends of dread and darkness. 

These abominations, they shift and change, cloaking themselves in the semblance of man. Yet their hearts are naught but foul. In search of the strongest among the living, those whom the King of the damned seeks to ensnare… to draw forth power most profane."

Join the fight in this indie action roguelite set in the medieval ages!
#indiegame #indiedev #pixelart #roguelite
